title: KV-streams for Efficient Compaction in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向智能体强化学习中高效压缩的 KV-streams

paragraphs.en: Scaling the horizon of agentic LLMs is bottlenecked by the need to fit ever longer context traces in GPU memory. Context compaction has been the most popular mechanism to alleviate this issue, keeping GPU memory constant for a given trace. Unfortunately, most compaction strategies rely on prefilling the LLM context many times over, hindering training throughput. To alleviate this bottleneck and enable efficient trainable compaction, we propose KV-streams , a plug-and-play strategy compatible with any compaction strategy that substantially increases throughput while showing no evidence of hindering performance. KV-streams enable scalable compaction by streaming the KV cache forward rather than flushing it after each compaction. We show that KV-streams enable three different compaction strategies, achieving a 2.6 2.6 to 5 × 5\times wall-clock speedup in training. Beyond efficiency, we find that the streamed KV cache can act as a recurrent state, carrying forward information that has long since disappeared from the context. Specifically, in a controlled setting we show that, contrary to prior work, RL alone is all that is needed for this behavior to emerge. Overall, we show KV-streams to be an efficient and lightweight plug-and-play addition to any post-training pipeline.

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning on long-horizon agentic tasks requires generating many concurrent rollouts, each having key-value (KV) caches growing linearly with length. Under a fixed GPU memory budget, the longest-running rollouts quickly become the bottleneck, monopolizing memory that shorter rollouts could otherwise use. Reducing the memory footprint of long traces can therefore substantially increase training throughput, enabling more optimizer steps and larger batch sizes ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在长时程智能体任务中，强化学习需要生成大量并发展开过程，而每个展开过程的键值（KV）缓存都会随长度线性增长。 在固定 GPU 内存预算下，运行时间最长的展开过程会迅速成为瓶颈，独占本可用于较短展开过程的内存。 因此，减少长轨迹的内存占用可以显著提升训练吞吐量，从而支持更多的优化器步数和更大的批量大小（Kwon et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: To stop memory from growing, a variety of compaction techniques can be used. They remove a portion of the context once a fixed token budget is exceeded (e.g. replacing older context with a summary) ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Compaction lets a trace extend indefinitely (in principle) without growing its memory footprint, but increases training compute. This is due to the retained context being prefilled each time following a compaction, so the model performs repeated forward passes over the same tokens ( Cim et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为防止内存持续增长，可以使用多种压缩技术。 一旦超过固定的令牌预算，这些技术就会移除部分上下文（例如，用摘要替换较旧的上下文）（Wu 等人，2026b；Li 等人，2026b）。 压缩使得追踪在原则上可以无限延伸而不会增加其内存占用，但会提升训练时的计算量。 这是因为每次压缩后，保留的上下文都会被预先填充，因此模型需要对相同的令牌重复进行前向传播（Cim 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose KV-streams to alleviate the computational bottleneck of compaction. Specifically, KV-streams evicts KV entries directly in the inference engine yielding the memory benefits of compaction while maintaining a single continuous stream of KVs, thus avoiding any repeated prefill cost. On the trainer side, KV-streams reproduce the eviction pattern with a custom attention mask, so no tokens are re-processed. Through this simple plugin, KV-streams substantially increase both training and inference throughput on the four compaction strategies we tested, and are compatible with others. Figure 2 summarizes those four strategies and the mechanism behind the speedup.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 KV-streams，以缓解压缩带来的计算瓶颈。 具体来说，KV-streams 直接在推理引擎中驱逐 KV 条目，从而获得与压缩相同的内存优势，同时保持单一的连续 KV 流，避免了任何重复的预填充开销。 在训练器端，KV-streams 通过自定义注意力掩码重现了驱逐模式，因此无需重新处理任何标记。 通过这一简单的插件，KV-streams 在我们测试的四种压缩策略上显著提升了训练和推理吞吐量，并且与其他策略兼容。 图 2 总结了这四种策略以及实现加速的机制。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate KV-streams combined with various compaction strategies on long-horizon agentic tasks, using Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and Qwen3.5-4B , obtaining a 5 × 5\times speedup on TextWorld ( Côté et al., 2019 ) and a 1.3 × 1.3\times speedup on ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) . Interestingly, while early in training both KV-streams and re-prefill compaction can hinder performance compared to the use of full context, with sufficient training, KV-streams can close this gap and even surpass the performance of full context. Further, we find that models trained with KV-streams also generalize better to unseen text-based games ( Cui et al., 2025 ; Hausknecht et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Jansen et al., 2024 ) . We then carry these results over to agentic software-engineering tasks, where KV-streams reach peak performance 3 × 3\times faster than full context while maintaining comparable performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在长期智能体任务中评估了 KV-streams 与多种压缩策略的结合效果，实验使用了 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 和 Qwen3.5-4B，在 TextWorld（Côté et al., 2019）上实现了 5 × 5\times 的速度提升，在 ALFWorld（Shridhar et al., 2021）上实现了 1.3 × 1.3\times 的速度提升。 有趣的是，尽管在训练初期，与使用完整上下文相比，KV-streams 和重新预填充压缩策略都可能对性能造成阻碍，但经过充分训练后，KV-streams 能够缩小这一差距，甚至超越完整上下文的性能。 此外，我们发现使用 KV-streams 训练的模型在未见的文本类游戏中也表现出更好的泛化能力（Cui et al., 2025；Hausknecht et al., 2020；Wang et al., 2022；Jansen et al., 2024）。 随后，我们将这些结果应用于智能体软件工程任务中，其中 KV-streams 达到峰值性能的速度比完整上下文快 3 × 3\times，同时仍能保持相当的性能水平。

paragraphs.en: Prior work ( Kontonis et al., 2026 ) showed that preserving KVs across compactions lets the KV cache act as a ”pseudo-recurrent” state, but found that this behaviour requires a preliminary SFT stage in their training setup. We test whether that requirement holds in our approach. Empirically, the additional wall-clock time spent on SFT does not improve performance, and synthetic experiments show that pseudo-recurrence can emerge in the KV cache without this preliminary SFT stage. This is a significant improvement for RL post training pipelines, with up to a 5 × 5\times speedup.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究（Kontonis 等人，2026）表明，在压缩过程中保留 KV 键值对能使 KV 缓存充当一种“伪循环”状态，但他们发现，这种行为在其训练设置中需要一个初步的 SFT 阶段。 我们测试了这一要求在我们的方法中是否仍然成立。 从经验上看，用于 SFT 的额外实际运行时间并未提升性能，而合成实验表明，即使没有这一初步的 SFT 阶段，KV 缓存中也能出现伪循环特性。 这对强化学习（RL）的后训练流程而言是一项重大改进，速度可提升高达 5 倍（5 × 5\times）。

paragraphs.en: Long-running LLM agents commonly manage context growth by summarizing earlier interactions or offloading information to external memory, keeping the active context within a fixed budget ( Packer et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . It is necessary to scale LLM context windows by preventing “context rot” and limiting growing KV-memory. During training, limiting these effects is quite important. For instance, a single long rollout can monopolize the inference server’s memory, throttling throughput. On top of that, agentic settings are specially affected by this hindrance as the environment’s feedback adds to the growing context. For instance, in software engineering, reading or writing a file can consume a substantial amount of context that may not be necessary at later stages of the task. Reducing this context is therefore important for scaling long-context agentic RL. While prior works have attempted to alleviate these issues Aghajohari et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a they either focus on non-agentic settings, which simplify the problem, they do not study its interaction with RL, or most detrimentally, they re-prefill the context incurring a high compute cost. Our goal is to fill these gaps and eliminate any redundant compute cost.
paragraphs.zh: 长期运行的 LLM 智能体通常通过总结早期交互或将其信息卸载到外部内存来管理上下文的增长，从而将活跃上下文限制在固定预算内（Packer 等人，2024；Wu 等人，2026b；Lu 等人，2025）。 必须通过防止“上下文老化”和限制 KV 内存的增长来扩展 LLM 的上下文窗口。 在训练过程中，限制这些影响至关重要。 例如，单次长时间推理过程可能会独占推理服务器的内存，从而降低吞吐量。 此外，智能体设置尤其受到这种阻碍的影响，因为环境的反馈会进一步增加不断增长的上下文。 例如，在软件工程领域，读取或写入文件可能会消耗大量上下文，而这些内容在任务的后续阶段可能并不必要。 因此，减少这种上下文对于扩展长上下文智能体强化学习至关重要。 尽管先前的研究试图缓解这些问题（Aghajohari 等人，2026；Wu 等人，2026a），但它们要么专注于非智能体设置（这简化了问题），要么没有研究其与强化学习的相互作用，或者最不利的是，它们重新预填充上下文，导致高昂的计算成本。 我们的目标是填补这些空白，并消除任何多余的计算成本。

sents.en: Long-running LLM agents commonly manage context growth by summarizing earlier interactions or offloading information to external memory, keeping the active context within a fixed budget ( Packer et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 长期运行的 LLM 智能体通常通过总结早期交互或将其信息卸载到外部内存来管理上下文的增长，从而将活跃上下文限制在固定预算内（Packer 等人，2024；Wu 等人，2026b；Lu 等人，2025）。

sents.en: It is necessary to scale LLM context windows by preventing “context rot” and limiting growing KV-memory.
sents.zh: 必须通过防止“上下文老化”和限制 KV 内存的增长来扩展 LLM 的上下文窗口。

sents.en: During training, limiting these effects is quite important.
sents.zh: 在训练过程中，限制这些影响至关重要。

sents.en: For instance, a single long rollout can monopolize the inference server’s memory, throttling throughput.
sents.zh: 例如，单次长时间推理过程可能会独占推理服务器的内存，从而降低吞吐量。

sents.en: On top of that, agentic settings are specially affected by this hindrance as the environment’s feedback adds to the growing context.
sents.zh: 此外，智能体设置尤其受到这种阻碍的影响，因为环境的反馈会进一步增加不断增长的上下文。

sents.en: For instance, in software engineering, reading or writing a file can consume a substantial amount of context that may not be necessary at later stages of the task.
sents.zh: 例如，在软件工程领域，读取或写入文件可能会消耗大量上下文，而这些内容在任务的后续阶段可能并不必要。

sents.en: Reducing this context is therefore important for scaling long-context agentic RL.
sents.zh: 因此，减少这种上下文对于扩展长上下文智能体强化学习至关重要。

sents.en: While prior works have attempted to alleviate these issues Aghajohari et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a they either focus on non-agentic settings, which simplify the problem, they do not study its interaction with RL, or most detrimentally, they re-prefill the context incurring a high compute cost.
sents.zh: 尽管先前的研究试图缓解这些问题（Aghajohari 等人，2026；Wu 等人，2026a），但它们要么专注于非智能体设置（这简化了问题），要么没有研究其与强化学习的相互作用，或者最不利的是，它们重新预填充上下文，导致高昂的计算成本。

sents.en: Our goal is to fill these gaps and eliminate any redundant compute cost.
sents.zh: 我们的目标是填补这些空白，并消除任何多余的计算成本。

paragraphs.en: To illustrate where this added cost comes from, we formalize compaction and show how KV-streams can be applied to any strategy that meets this definition. We note that our experiments are in agentic settings, which require turn -wise compaction (see Appendix B.4 ), but we use a generalized entry-level view to describe the process, which generalizes to tokens/turns. KV-streams is readily amenable to other long-context use cases as well.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate KV-streams on two text-based games and on software-engineering tasks. Both settings test whether an agent can carry information forward once older context is compacted. Text-based games often require recalling details received early in the episode, so compaction can hurt performance if the agent fails to retain them. Software-engineering tasks involve reading and writing long files, and removing these files from context can discard information the agent later relies on. The text-based games use Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and the software-engineering tasks use Qwen3.5-4B . Across benchmarks we sample 8 8 rollouts per prompt and use a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Within each benchmark, all runs share the same optimization settings and differ only in the compaction strategy. We report evaluation score against cumulative GPU-hours, and we stop a run early only when its wall-clock time exceeds that of the full-context run.

paragraphs.en: TextWorld ( Côté et al., 2019 ) provides procedurally generated games across four task families (coin_collector, cooking, simple, treasure_hunter) at three difficulty levels. We generate 60,000 synthetic games split uniformly across task families and difficulties, and retain 256 representative tasks for evaluation. Compaction triggers every 10 10 turns, and episodes run for up to 200 200 turns within a 32 32 k-token budget. We train for 500 500 gradient steps with a batch size of 512 512 on an 8 8 -GPU H100 node ( 4 4 inference, 4 4 trainer), and report mean avg@1 on the evaluation tasks.

paragraphs.en: Our aim is to show the speedup at as close to production scale as possible, so we build on asynchronous RL frameworks that decouple the trainer and inference GPUs. For the text-based games, we run a forked vLLM inference engine and a forked prime-RL ( Team et al., 2025 ) trainer 1 1 1 Forked from https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-rl . Our code: https://github.com/Emilianopp/KV-streams . , both modified to support KV-streams. Our vLLM configuration uses 16 16 -token KV-cache blocks ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) . Only complete blocks are added to the prefix cache. 2 2 2 https://docs.vllm.ai/en/v0.9.1/design/v1/prefix_caching.html When a request does not end on a multiple of 16 16 , the trailing tokens stay uncommitted until a later request completes the group. This breaks the stream, since the next request may evict tokens that the uncommitted tokens would have attended to, and we initially found it to substantially hinder performance. We fix it by padding each completion to a multiple of 16 16 tokens. The padding must be prefilled by both the inference engine and the trainer, which inflates the total token count. We account for this in Figure 4 and describe it in Appendix B.3 . Despite this inefficiency, KV-streams still improves throughput. On the trainer side we use asynchronous RL with a maximum off-policy lag of 3 3 , and we modify prime-RL to apply in-flight weight updates without flushing the KV cache ( Piché et al., 2026 ) . This change is important for scaling KV-streams, since flushing on every weight update would force a prefill of entire, possibly long, traces and undo the memory savings. For the software-engineering experiments, we instead use a forked Slime trainer with a forked SGLang inference engine 3 3 3 https://github.com/Emilianopp/sglang , which commits individual tokens with a block size of 1 1 and therefore needs no padding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是展示尽可能接近生产规模时的加速效果，因此我们基于异步强化学习框架进行构建，该框架将训练 GPU 和推理 GPU 解耦。 对于文本类游戏，我们运行了一个分叉的 vLLM 推理引擎和一个分叉的 prime-RL（Team et al., 2025）训练器 1 1 1 分叉自 https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-rl。 我们的代码：https://github.com/Emilianopp/KV-streams。两者均经过修改以支持 KV-streams。 我们的 vLLM 配置使用 16 个 16-token 的 KV-cache 块（Kwon et al., 2023）。 只有完整的块才会被添加到前缀缓存中。2 2 2 https://docs.vllm.ai/en/v0.9.1/design/v1/prefix_caching.html 当一个请求的长度不是 16 的倍数时，多余的 token 将保持未提交状态，直到后续请求完成该组。 这会破坏流式处理，因为下一个请求可能会驱逐那些未提交的 token 本应参与的 token，我们最初发现这严重影响了性能。 我们通过将每次补全结果填充到 16 的倍数 token 来解决这个问题。 填充必须由推理引擎和训练器共同预先填充，这会增加总 token 数量。 我们在图 4 中考虑了这一点，并在附录 B.3 中进行了描述。 尽管存在这种低效性，KV-streams 仍然能够提升吞吐量。 在训练器端，我们使用异步强化学习，最大离策略延迟为 3，并对 prime-RL 进行了修改，使其能够在不刷新 KV 缓存的情况下应用飞行中的权重更新（Piché et al., 2026）。 这一改动对于扩展 KV-streams 至关重要，因为每次权重更新都进行刷新将迫使整个可能很长的轨迹被预先填充，从而抵消内存节省效果。 对于软件工程实验，我们则使用一个分叉的 Slime 训练器和一个分叉的 SGLang 推理引擎 3 3 3 https://github.com/Emilianopp/sglang，该引擎以 1 为块大小提交单个 token，因此无需填充。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows success rate against GPU-hours on TextWorld and ALFWorld for every compaction strategy under re-prefill compaction and under KV-streams. On TextWorld, KV-streams reaches the final performance of re-prefill compaction with between 3.7 × 3.7\times and 11.3 × 11.3\times fewer GPU-hours, while performing better or similarly. Regardless, KV-streams still achieves an increased throughput between 1.3 × 1.3\times and 3.0 × 3.0\times . KV-streams again reaches the final success rate of re-prefill compaction without incurring a performance loss across the four strategies. paragraphs.en: Figure 5 breaks the time per step into generation and forward/backward. paragraphs.en: We aim to evaluate whether the speedups from KV-streams come at the cost of worse transfer to other tasks. We evaluate on unseen text-based games ( Cui et al., 2025 ; Hausknecht et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Jansen et al., 2024 ) using the final checkpoint from the TextWorld runs, with the same budget and context settings as training ( B = 10 B=10 turns and a 32 32 k-token context limit). Figure 7 A reports the score for each game averaged over three seeds. For every game, a version of KV-streams performs on par with the best strategy. A version of KV-streams also improves upon the base model in every game, showing that learning on TextWorld transfers to other text-based games. No single compaction strategy performs best across all games (Figure 7 A), consistent with broader findings that memory-method performance depends on the task ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Regardless, we find no loss in transfer for KV-streams compared to full context and re-prefill compaction.

paragraphs.en: Using the training set described in Section 4 , we train for 200 200 gradient steps and evaluate on SWE-bench Verified, a standard software-engineering benchmark of 500 500 Python bug fixes. Figure 6 shows the evaluation results (left) and the training reward (right). To measure final performance, we evaluate the last checkpoint of each run over three seeds. Sliding-Window with KV-streams reaches 52.7 ± 2.1 % 52.7\pm 2.1\% , statistically within the margin of error of full context ( 51.5 ± 1.2 % 51.5\pm 1.2\% ) and re-prefill Markovian Thinker ( 53.4 ± 0.2 % 53.4\pm 0.2\% ). Our results therefore remain consistent with the text-based games, finding no significant degradation in performance compared to full context. As before, KV-streams substantially reduces wall-clock time. Sliding-Window with KV-streams reaches its peak in about 20 20 hours compared to more than 65 65 hours for full context, a 3 × 3\times speedup. The gap persists when comparing Markovian Thinker under re-prefill compaction and under KV-streams, where KV-streams reaches its peak in about 32 32 hours versus about 60 60 hours for re-prefill.

paragraphs.en: Since retained KVs attended to tokens that are no longer in the context, prior work has shown they can act as a psudo-recurrent state ( Kontonis et al., 2026 ) , carrying forward information that has since been removed from the context. Because the model was not pretrained with this in mind, prior work relies on supervised fine-tuning to make the behaviour emerge as a first post training stage, before RL fine tuning can be done. We ask if this two-stage post training is necessary, and test whether KV-streams can enable direct RL fine tuning without an SFT stage. We test this by comparing cost savings of skipping an SFT warm start on TextWorld, and we analyze the mechanisms giving rise to this pseudo recurrent state in a controlled synthetic experiment
paragraphs.zh: 由于保留的 KV 会关注那些已不在上下文中的标记，先前的研究已经表明，它们可以充当一种伪循环状态（Kontonis 等人，2026），将随后从上下文中移除的信息延续下去。 由于模型并非为此目的进行预训练，先前的研究依赖于监督微调，使这种行为在强化学习微调之前，作为训练后的第一阶段显现出来。 我们提出疑问：这种两阶段的后续训练是否必要？并测试 KV 流是否能够在没有 SFT 阶段的情况下实现直接的强化学习微调。 我们通过比较在 TextWorld 中跳过 SFT 预热启动所能节省的成本来验证这一假设，并在受控的合成实验中分析产生这种伪循环状态的机制。

paragraphs.en: If SFT were a necessary precursor for this recurrent behaviour, we would expect performance to be better with prior SFT. To analyze this and remove the confounder of SFT from a better model, we collect 10k trajectories from Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 with a 32k context limit (matching RL training), then perform SFT on those traces using randomly sampled eviction attention masks. For instance, sometimes we do sliding window with B = 10 B=10 and a stride equal to 1, other times we use Markovian Thinker truncation masking half the context ( B = N / 2 B=N/2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 如果 SFT 是这种重复行为所必需的先行步骤，那么我们应当预期在先前经过 SFT 训练的情况下性能会更好。 为了分析这一点，并从更优模型中消除 SFT 这一干扰因素，我们从 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 上收集了 1 万条轨迹（上下文长度限制为 32k，与 RL 训练一致），然后使用随机采样的驱逐注意力掩码对这些轨迹进行 SFT 训练。 例如，有时我们会采用滑动窗口方法，其中 B = 10，步长为 1；而另一些时候，我们则会使用马尔可夫思考者截断法，对上下文的一半进行掩码处理（B = N / 2）。

sents.en: For instance, sometimes we do sliding window with B = 10 B=10 and a stride equal to 1, other times we use Markovian Thinker truncation masking half the context ( B = N / 2 B=N/2 ).

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 B compares RL from the base model against an SFT warm-start followed by RL ( Vattikonda et al., 2025 ) . The model fits the full-context loss (Appendix C.2 shows the SFT training curve), yet once SFT compute is counted, RL alone is more compute efficient and shows no observable drop in performance. paragraphs.en: The prior experiment shows empirically that KV-streams does not depend on prior SFT. Here we test this systematically with a controlled synthetic task. The model is first assigned an object (a fruit) and then asked to decode a sequence of numbers, with a budget of k k tokens. Next we evict the turn containing the assignment and ask the model which object it was assigned, choosing from a list of candidates. After eviction the assignment no longer appears in the model’s input, so the model cannot reference it and instructing the model to count numbers ensures it does not leak the object in its own context. Thus, it can recover the object only if the tokens it decoded while the assignment was still visible encoded that information in their KV entries, which KV-streams carries forward. We vary the number of decoded tokens k ∈ { 16 , 32 , 64 , 128 , 256 , 512 } k\in\{16,32,64,128,256,512\} to test whether recall scales with the capacity of the KV-cache. Two further evaluations modify this base setting. The first asks whether a model trained to recall fruits generalizes to a new class of objects (actors). The second asks whether training can extend recall to an object the base model assigns zero probability to, by asking for a TV when the prompt lists only fruits as candidates.

paragraphs.en: In the first task the model must retrieve the evicted assignment from a list of five candidate fruits, one of which is the assignment. Because the list always contains the answer, random sampling under RL produces some successes from the start, and the model can bootstrap from them. Figure 8 A illustrates the setup and reports the results. As the KV-cache budget grows, recall rises to 100 % 100\% and matches SFT. It becomes unreliable only at the smallest budgets of 16 16 and 32 32 tokens. KV-streams therefore learns to carry the assignment forward through RL alone, without an SFT stage. While this result is sufficient to show that information can be leaked through KVs alone, it is restricted in the setting that it could overfit to the specific use case making things less reliable, as well as the support between the model with evicted context and unevicted context always had overlap, i.e., the both full context and evicted had sufficient probability over the assigned fruit.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一个任务中，模型必须从五个候选水果的列表中检索被驱逐的分配结果，其中一个是正确的分配。 由于该列表始终包含答案，强化学习（RL）下的随机采样从一开始就能产生一些成功结果，模型可以据此进行自启动。 图 8A 展示了实验设置并报告了结果。 随着 KV 缓存预算的增加，召回率上升至 100% 100\%，并与 SFT 的结果一致。 仅在最小的预算（16 16 和 32 32 个词元）下，该结果才变得不可靠。 因此，KV-streams 仅通过强化学习（RL）就能学会将分配结果传递下去，而无需 SFT 阶段。 虽然这一结果足以表明信息可以通过 KV 本身泄露，但在此设定中，它存在局限性：模型可能会针对特定用例过度拟合，从而降低可靠性；此外，使用被驱逐上下文的模型与未驱逐上下文的模型之间的支持始终存在重叠，即完整上下文和驱逐后的上下文在分配水果上都具有足够的概率。

Given a sufficient KV-token budget, KV-streams trained with SFT and with RL generalizes beyond the training domain.

paragraphs.en: Finally, we test whether RL can teach the model to recall an object it would never sample once the assignment turn is evicted. We assign one of six objects at random, five fruits and a television, but at recall we list only the five fruits as options. The base model therefore places almost no probability on the television and would not sample it on its own. A model with full context, by contrast, can always recall that it was assigned the television. This lets us test whether information carried in the KV-cache can align the compacted model’s distribution with the full-context one, bringing in a token that would otherwise never be sampled. SFT has no difficulty here by construction, since it forces the target response. Figure 8 C shows that RL learns this behaviour as well, and as the KV-token budget grows it recalls the television 100 % 100\% of the time. Even in this hardest case, RL alone aligns the compacted distribution with that of full context.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们测试强化学习（RL）能否教会模型回忆一个对象：一旦分配回合被驱逐，该模型就绝不会采样这个对象。 我们随机分配六个对象中的一个——五个水果和一台电视——但在回忆时，我们只列出五个水果作为选项。 因此，基础模型几乎不会给电视分配任何概率，也不会自行采样它。 相比之下，拥有完整上下文的模型总能回忆起自己被分配了电视这一事实。 这使我们能够测试：KV缓存中携带的信息能否将压缩模型的分布与完整上下文模型的对齐，从而引入一个原本绝不会被采样的词元。 根据构造，SFT在此任务中毫无困难，因为它强制输出了目标响应。 图8C显示，强化学习（RL）也能学会这种行为；随着KV词元预算的增加，它100% 100\% 的情况下都能回忆起电视。 即使在这种最困难的情况下，仅靠强化学习（RL）也能将压缩后的分布与完整上下文模型的对齐。

paragraphs.en: Overall, our empirical and synthetic experiments show that RL alone is enough for the model to carry information forward through the KV-cache, given sufficient KV-cache capacity, and that no expensive SFT stage is needed. This broadens the applicability of KV-streams. It becomes a plug-and-play mechanism that can be added at post-training without any additional pipeline stage.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的实证和合成实验表明，只要 KV-cache 容量足够，仅通过 RL 就足以让模型通过 KV-cache 传递信息，而无需任何耗时的 SFT 阶段。 这扩大了 KV-streams 的应用范围。 它成为一种即插即用的机制，可以在训练后添加，而无需任何额外的处理流程阶段。

paragraphs.en: Many methods keep long-context generation affordable by capping how much each new token can cost. Some rewrite the model itself, as in recurrent and state-space architectures, which hold cost flat but only after the model is retrained to use them ( Gu and Dao, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) . Transformer-XL carries hidden states between segments ( Dai et al., 2019 ) , while Compressive Transformer compresses older memories for subsequent attention ( Rae et al., 2020 ) . GTrXL adapts Transformer-XL for stable reinforcement learning in memory-dependent environments ( Parisotto et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 许多方法通过限制每个新词符的成本上限，使长上下文生成保持经济可行。 一些方法会重写模型本身，例如循环和状态空间架构，这些方法能保持成本稳定，但前提是模型必须经过重新训练以采用它们（Gu and Dao, 2024；Yang et al., 2025；Fu et al., 2025）。 Transformer-XL 在不同片段之间传递隐藏状态（Dai et al., 2019），而 Compressive Transformer 则对旧的记忆进行压缩，以便后续注意力机制使用（Rae et al., 2020）。 GTrXL 将 Transformer-XL 进行了适配，使其能够在依赖记忆的环境中实现稳定的强化学习（Parisotto et al., 2020）。

paragraphs.en: Others leave the pretrained model untouched and simply hold the context to a fixed size, most often by summarizing old turns or keeping the most recent ones ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ) . The second family is convenient but pays a hidden tax, since every time the budget is hit the window is torn down and rebuilt, and the same tokens are pushed through the model again ( Cim et al., 2026 ; Aghajohari et al., 2026 ; Kontonis et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ) . That repeated work is the prefill cost we study in Section 2 , and it is what makes these runs jagged and starves the GPU. KV-streams targets this tax directly. We retain whatever the strategy chooses to keep, but rather than rebuild the window we drop the evicted keys and values inside the inference engine and mirror that drop in the trainer with an attention mask. The upshot is a smooth, steady cost per token that does not depend on which compaction rule is in play, close in spirit to schemes like attention sinks ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) that sidestep rebuilding but without committing to one fixed retention pattern. In concurrent work, sliding windows over the KV cache have also been shown to be an efficient alternative for long generations, for test-time scaling ( Muennighoff et al., 2026 ) and against linear attention ( Jolicoeur-Martineau et al., 2026 ) . KV-streams is complementary, since it applies to any compaction strategy and removes the re-prefill cost of training it with RL. Inference-time cache eviction is also studied by H 2 O, which retains recent and high-attention tokens ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , and TOVA, which interprets Transformers as multi-state RNNs and bounds their state through KV-cache compression ( Oren et al., 2024 ) . Our focus is on efficient agentic RL training that reproduces the inference-time eviction pattern.
paragraphs.zh: 其他方法则对预训练模型不作改动，仅将上下文限制在固定大小内，通常通过总结旧对话轮次或保留最新对话轮次来实现（Wu et al., 2026b；Li et al., 2026b）。 第二类方法虽便捷，但存在隐性代价：每当预算额度用尽时，窗口就会被拆除并重新构建，相同的标记会再次被送入模型处理（Cim et al., 2026；Aghajohari et al., 2026；Kontonis et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2026a）。 这种重复操作正是我们在第 2 节中研究的预填充成本，它导致这些运行过程出现波动，并造成 GPU 资源不足。 KV-streams 直接针对这一隐性代价进行优化。 我们保留策略选择保留的所有内容，但不会重新构建窗口，而是将淘汰的键值对丢弃在推理引擎中，并通过注意力掩码在训练器中镜像这一丢弃操作。 其结果是每标记成本平滑且稳定，不依赖于具体使用的压缩规则，在理念上与注意力池（Xiao et al., 2024）等方案相近——这些方案避免了重新构建，但并未固定采用某种保留模式。 在并行研究中，对 KV 缓存使用滑动窗口也被证明是长生成任务中的高效替代方案，适用于测试时扩展（Muennighoff et al., 2026）以及对抗线性注意力机制（Jolicoeur-Martineau et al., 2026）。 KV-streams 与其互补，因为它适用于任何压缩策略，并消除了通过强化学习训练该方法所需的重复预填充成本。 H2O 也研究了推理时的缓存淘汰机制，它保留近期且注意力高的标记（Zhang et al., 2023）；而 TOVA 则将 Transformer 解释为多状态 RNN，并通过 KV 缓存压缩来限制其状态规模（Oren et al., 2024）。 我们的研究重点在于高效的智能体强化学习训练，以复现推理时的淘汰模式。

paragraphs.en: A related line of work trains the model to manage its own context, so that the content surviving a compaction is itself learned, as a generated summary in some methods and as a compact memory state in others ( Yan et al., 2026b ; Yan et al., 2026a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.zh: 相关研究则训练模型管理其自身上下文，使得压缩后保留的内容本身被学习：在某些方法中，它表现为生成的摘要；在另一些方法中，则表现为紧凑的记忆状态（Yan et al., 2026b; Yan et al., 2026a; Zhou et al., 2026; Li et al., 2026b; Lu et al., 2025）。 这些方法会决定保留哪些内容，并且每次压缩后都会重建窗口，因此保留的内容会被重新预填充，而我们所研究的训练成本对这些方法保持不变。 KV-streams 与此选择无关。 它并未提出新的压缩规则，而是使任何规则的训练成本更低，因此这些学习到的策略可以在其基础上运行。

paragraphs.en: We introduce KV-streams, a plug-and-play mechanism that is compatible with any compaction strategy. We show that by avoiding the repeated prefill cost, KV-streams substantially reduces experiment wall-time, providing up to a 3 × 3\times speedup while often improving performance and at worst not hindering it. Further, we show that streamed KVs can act as a pseudo-recurrent state, carrying forward information that has long been removed from the context. Unlike prior work, we show that prior SFT is not a prerequisite for this effect to occur, which greatly simplifies the adoption of KV-streams. Overall, we show that KV-streams is a simple and effective way to substantially increase experiment throughput.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 KV-streams，这是一种即插即用的机制，可与任何压缩策略兼容。 研究表明，通过避免重复的预填充开销，KV-streams 能显著缩短实验的实际运行时间，实现高达 3 × 3\times 的速度提升，同时通常还能提升性能，最坏情况下也不会对性能造成阻碍。 此外，我们还表明，流式传输的 KV 可以充当一种伪循环状态，保留那些早已被从上下文中移除的信息。 与先前的研究不同，我们证明了此前的 SFT 并非产生这种效果的前提条件，这极大地简化了 KV-streams 的应用。 总体而言，我们表明 KV-streams 是一种简单而有效的方法，能够显著提升实验的吞吐量。

paragraphs.en: KV-streams lowers the cost of training long-running agents by reducing repeated prefill. These savings may also make harmful or unauthorized automation cheaper. Agents handling sensitive information still need access controls, monitoring, and secure data handling. We release no new pretrained models or datasets. KV-streams does not replace the safety policies, permissions, or privacy protections of the underlying models and environments.
paragraphs.zh: KV-streams 通过减少重复的预填充，降低了训练长期运行智能体的成本。 这些成本节省也可能使有害或未经授权的自动化变得更便宜。 处理敏感信息的智能体仍然需要访问控制、监控和安全的數據處理机制。 我们不发布任何新的预训练模型或数据集。 KV-streams 不会取代底层模型和环境的安全策略、权限或隐私保护措施。

paragraphs.en: Token-level eviction produced degenerate text in our initial experiments. The model required substantial SFT before its generations began to improve. We suspect that removing message-boundary tokens disrupts the format learned during pre- and mid-training. Evicting complete turns caused no such instability in the initial responses, so we use turn-wise compaction in the agentic experiments. It gives less precise control over context length and per-trace memory use. Training with token-level eviction masks during mid-training may allow finer-grained eviction.
paragraphs.zh: 在初步实验中，基于词元的驱逐策略生成了退化的文本。 在该模型生成的内容开始改善之前，需要大量的监督微调（SFT）。 我们推测，移除消息边界词元会破坏模型在预训练和中期训练期间学到的格式。 驱逐完整的对话回合并未导致初始响应出现此类不稳定性，因此在智能体实验中，我们采用按回合压缩的方法。 这种方法对上下文长度和每条轨迹的内存使用控制精度较低。 在中期训练阶段使用基于词元的驱逐掩码进行训练，或许能够实现更精细的驱逐控制。

paragraphs.en: We sample on-policy batches of 128 128 trajectories, with four rollouts per assignment, at temperature 1.0 1.0 and top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 . Reward is one for an exact post-eviction match with no candidate answer in the decoded sequence, and zero otherwise. The loss weights each generated response token’s negative log-probability by its trajectory’s advantage. The advantage uses a batch-wide leave-one-out baseline: the mean reward of the other 127 127 trajectories. If every answer in the batch is incorrect, the baseline is chance accuracy ( 1 / 5 1/5 for five fruits and 1 / 6 1/6 for the six-target TV task). We add no supervised target loss.
